title: The scheduler hashes each `TaskId` with SipHash, which is 1.4% of a hello request and 0.8% of a waiting one.
text: A `TaskId` is the scheduler's own number and never a value a request supplies, so no input can grow a bucket and an unkeyed hash is safe there. Closing it is the scheduler's task map on `rustc_hash`, with a comment saying why the key needs no seed, and the hello profile from `bun nv bench-compare --profile hello` showing the SipHash rows gone.
